name: test_futures_limit_long_reduce
description:
Test complete flow: Create a Long limit order (with size big enough to reduce),
    verify the position, attach TP/SL, and then execute a 50% reduce-only short order.
    Verify that the position size decreases and no opposing short position is opened.

steps.name: Step 1: Fetch Coin Pair Config and Validate Required Fields for BTC/USDT
Step 2: Fetch Order Book and Get Current Ask Price
Step 3: Adjust Leverage to 3X before placing order
Step 4: Frame Payload and Take Trade (Long Limit Order) for qty 0.0024
Step 5: Wait for Initial Order Execution
Step 7: Place TP / SL on Active Position
Step 9: Place Reduce-Only SHORT Limit Order (50% of position)
Step 10: Wait for Reduce Order Execution
Step 11: Verify Quantity Reduced and No Opposite Position Created

labels.name: story
labels.value: Futures Limit Orders: Take Long Trade and Apply 50% Reduce-Only Position
